description: Look up static blockchain network metadata and chain IDs for supported EVM and Solana networks. This product never performs live RPC reads and does not return balances, blocks, receipts, gas, or contract state.

chain_id.description: Optional EVM decimal chain ID. Omit network and chain_id to return the full static registry.

network.description: Optional network name or alias such as base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum-one, optimism, or solana.

name: get_chain_network_info
